summary: In our project, we help children learn about space, celestial bodies, and space missions. Adventures aligned with space missions not only allow children to explore space but also teach them about the situations that may arise during space missions and how to handle them.
details:
Uzay Maceram 3D (My Space Adventure) is an interactive 3D educational space simulation designed to help children explore space, celestial bodies, and space missions through engaging, decision-based adventures.

The project allows children to experience prepared space missions and learn how astronauts and spacecraft respond to unexpected situations during space exploration. Instead of simply reading scientific information or answering traditional quiz questions, players actively participate in simulated missions and make important decisions at critical moments.

The game features five advanced space missions, each consisting of multiple stages. Players navigate through three-dimensional space using a Cartesian X, Y, Z coordinate system and explore different environments, including the Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and deep space.

A central feature is its interactive decision-making mechanism. When a critical situation occurs, the simulation pauses and presents the player with possible actions. Players must select an appropriate response, observe the outcome, and learn the scientific reasoning behind the result. These scenarios introduce basic concepts of space navigation, spacecraft movement, engineering decisions, and the challenges of operating in space.

The project also includes astronaut and spacecraft customization. Players can personalize their astronaut's helmet, visor, spacesuit, colors, and spacecraft identity before entering the missions.

Educational technology guides and an interactive science information panel explain scientific concepts throughout the experience. Mission reports provide feedback on player decisions and mission performance.

For accessibility, the game includes a text-to-speech feature that reads on-screen information aloud. Its interface supports seven languages: Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, and Italian.

The technical infrastructure is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. SVG graphics support visual elements and customization, Web Audio API provides sound effects, and Web Speech API enables text-to-speech functionality.

The educational purpose of Uzay Maceram 3D is to encourage curiosity about space while developing critical thinking, problem-solving, scientific awareness, and decision-making skills. Children learn by experiencing mission scenarios, evaluating possible actions, observing consequences, and understanding the science behind space exploration.

Uzay Maceram 3D is an independent educational project and is not developed, sponsored, or officially endorsed by NASA or any other space agency.
